text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday! I'm looking forward to 
seeing the new Mave-chan in action!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
A new me?!?! What's that? That sounds so 
totally marvelous☆

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Because Mave-chan has grown so much, 
hasn't she?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Like a bud gathering strength through the 
winter, putting in steady effort day by 
day—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
All that hard work made a flower bloom—a 
whole new Mabe-chan that's different from 
last year! A truly gorgeous and strong 
flower, you know♪

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, what do I do!? Laurel's birthday 
wishes are making Marvelous swell bigger 
and bigger—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
It's Neo-Marvelous and Maxi-Marvelous☆★☆ 
This is the new me, after all!★☆★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
A new me☆ A new Marvelous★ With this, I 
can run anywhere and everywhere☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, for sure! Have a wonderful year 
running your heart out♪
